title: no-test-regression criterion fails for spec-required test edits
description: The no-test-regression pass condition states 'no test file edited' unconditionally, but some specifications (like moeb.start-commands-tool-schema-preload Step 8) explicitly require editing test construction sites when struct definitions change. This produces a guaranteed criterion failure for structurally compliant runs.
proposed_resolution: Update no-test-regression pass condition to distinguish test edits required by the specification (acceptable) from unrelated test modifications (not acceptable). For example: 'no test file edited unless the specification Steps explicitly require it; cargo test exits 0'.
